tips.text: Leave and re-queue the bounty until it contains an Assassinate stage; leave to Cetus and re-queue the tent bounties to reset them.
Re-queue if the Rictus Alpha spawns; only the Auger Alpha carries the blueprint.
Use Wisp motes or a flying companion to cut each bounty run to about a minute.
Bring a long-range primary and a high-damage secondary on a frame like Gara, Mesa, Rhino or Nekros.
Craft Fersteel Alloy and stock Grokdrul and Salvage before the event so you can build the moment it drops.
Players treat Quartakk as mastery fodder and use the Kuva Quartakk instead.
Ghoul Purge is short and easy once active; the only complaint is waiting for it to return.
